content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am trying to set up communication between my Raspberry Pi and a [product_name] using the snap7 library. I've managed to install the library on the Raspberry Pi, but now I'm facing an issue—the snap7 client isn't able to connect to the PLC. Could anyone assist me in resolving this problem? Thanks in advance
Hello! Were you able to find a solution?

analysis.insight_summary: A user is trying to connect their Raspberry Pi, which has snap7 installed, to a [product_name] PLC. Installation of snap7 was successful, but connection issues with the snap7 client remain unresolved. The discussion includes a follow-up request for an update but no working solution.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to establish seamless communication between the snap7 client on Raspberry Pi and the [product_name] PLC.
